activateCand(address,uint256).details: Called by AddressBookV2 only after manager and stake checks.      VRank performs slot limit checks using valCount and local candidate arrays.

params.nodeId: The address of the node to activate
The address of the node to add

returns._0: The current epoch based on block number

deactivateCand(address).details: Called by AddressBookV2 only after manager check.

params.nodeId: The address of the node to deactivate

epochTransition(address[],address[],addr.details: Called by core client as system tx at epoch block. Handles candidate transitions      locally and forwards validator diffs to AddressBookV2.

params.changedValIds: Validator nodes whose state changed this epoch
params.changedValStates: New states for changedValIds (Candidate = leaving validator sets)
params.newCandInactiveIds: Demoted candidates (testing failed + ready failed) → CandInactive

getCandIdsByState(uint8).details: Mirrors getValIdsByState on ABv2 for the two bounded candidate sets.      Returns empty array for Unknown (CandInactive is unbounded; use isCandInactive for point query).

returns._0: Array of node ids in the specified candidate state
The maximum number of ready candidates
The proposal failure count for the node in that epoch
The score for the node in that epoch (0 if not set)

initialLegacyValidators(address[]).details: Called by core client as system tx.      Initialize legacy validators' state to `ValActive`

params.initialValIds: Validator nodes whose state changed this epoch

returns._0: True if the node is in candInactiveIds
True if initialLegacyValidators has been called

params.nodeId: The address of the candidate to register

reportProposalFailure(address[]).details: Called by core client as system tx. Increments proposal failure count and calls      vrankPause on AddressBookV2, or vrankExit if count reaches exitThreshold.

params.nodeIds: The addresses of the failing validators

reportStakingViolation(address[]).details: Called by core client as system tx. No stake validation inside — caller is trusted.      Calls vrankExit on AddressBookV2 for each node; ABv2 silently returns if state      is invalid or exit slot is full. Does not increment proposalFailures.

params.nodeIds: The addresses of the nodes with insufficient stake

rescueOrphanedCandidate(address).details: Called by AddressBookV2 only. Reverts if node is already in any candidate array.

params.nodeId: The address of the orphaned node to rescue
The address of the candidate to unregister

params.newMaxReadyCandidateCount: The new maximum number of ready candidates

params.newMaxValidatorCount: The new maximum number of validators

updateScores(address[],uint256[]).details: Called by core client as system tx to record VRank scores

params.scores: Array of scores corresponding to each node

addCandInactive(address).notice: Adds a node to candInactiveIds (for offboard/expireIdle transitions)

epochTransition(address[],address[],addr.notice: Executes all epoch transitions in a single atomic operation

getCandIdsByState(uint8).notice: Returns all node ids in a specific candidate pipeline state

getMaxReadyCandidateCount().notice: Returns the maximum number of ready candidates

getMaxValidatorCount().notice: Returns the maximum number of validators

getProposalFailureCount(uint256,address).notice: Returns the proposal failure count for a node in a specific epoch

getScore(uint256,address).notice: Returns the score for a node in a specific epoch

isCandInactive(address).notice: Checks if a node is in the candInactiveIds set

isLegacyValidatorInitialized().notice: Returns whether the legacy validator set has been initialized

registerCandidate(address).notice: Registers a new candidate in VRank (adds to candInactiveIds)

reportProposalFailure(address[]).notice: Reports a proposal failure for a validator

reportStakingViolation(address[]).notice: Reports that a node's stake has dropped below MIN_STAKE

rescueOrphanedCandidate(address).notice: Rescues an orphaned candidate by adding it to candInactiveIds

setExitThreshold(uint256).notice: Sets the exit threshold (number of proposal failures to trigger vrankExit instead of vrankPause)

unregisterCandidate(address).notice: Unregisters a candidate from VRank (removes from candInactiveIds)

updateMaxReadyCandidateCount(uint256).notice: Updates the maximum number of ready candidates

updateMaxValidatorCount(uint256).notice: Updates the maximum number of validators

updateScores(address[],uint256[]).notice: Updates candidate scores for the current epoch
